fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami municipal governance, urging the new city commission to hire a capable city manager and address public utility franchises, harbor administration, and public improvements. Coverage highlights Miami as a growing convention city, with reports and satire related to the Lions convention and anticipated future conventions (including Shriners and Elks), plus discussion of the need for a downtown auditorium. Additional pieces touch on rumors of oil in the Everglades and concerns about triggering another real-estate boom; local society and gossip columns; parade highlights; and a substantial legal notice announcing a master’s foreclosure sale in Dade County.
